did_you_know: Rainspouts in the form of mythical elephant-crocodiles (makara) hold yellow flags in their trunks.
description: A king sits on a throne with a yogic band around his legs, listening to the music of two sages: a blue-skinned sage on a stringed instrument (vina), and a white-skinned one playing cymbals. A standing percussionist accompanies them on a drum. An attendant behind the king holds the royal canopy over his head.
